claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal Dan P. Berry is confirmed as the Army entrant represented by the exact-name and private-identifier match in the official merged file.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The full name and private service identifier match across the OSS index and official Army-entry file; the identifier is withheld.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed by an exact private identifier and exact normalized full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army-entry record is dated June 15, 1943; the later OSS sequence is not established.
claims.match_notes: The public profile masks the private identifier and does not infer a school or employer from the grouped occupation code.

claims.claim_text: Dan P. Berry's Army-entry record classifies his civilian occupation as a secondary-school teacher or principal.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The fixed-width Army record carries occupation code 031, which NARA's official code table defines as teachers at secondary schools and principals.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Confirmed through the exact private identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: Strongly date-bounded at Army entry on June 15, 1943, but no school, employer, or OSS transfer date is documented.
claims.match_notes: The grouped code is not converted into a specific teaching role, principalship, school, or employer.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The visually verified index supplies Clyde B. Berry, Corporal, and Box 53, but no private identifier. Exact-name official, CIA, OSS, military, employment, occupation, institutional, obituary, directory, and archival searches did not provide two corroborating identifiers beyond the name.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Review Box 53 for a private identifier, age, hometown, employment history, and Army-to-OSS sequence.

research_attempts.query_text: Clyde B. Berry: visually verified NARA index; public NARA Catalog context; CIA Reading Room; Library of Congress API; exact-name OSS and Corporal variants; employment, occupation, military, institutional, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Military, obituary, cemetery, and directory candidates lacked an OSS connection, Box 53 reference, or two corroborating identifiers beyond the name.
research_attempts.research_notes: The index row has no private identifier. Rank plus name alone did not securely resolve a candidate.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 53 for a private identifier, age, hometown, employment history, and Army-to-OSS sequence.

research_attempts.query_text: Dan P. Berry: visually verified NARA index and exact private-identifier Army check; public NARA Catalog context; CIA Reading Room; Library of Congress API; exact-name OSS and Corporal variants; teacher, principal, school, employment, newspaper, obituary, directory, and archival searches.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Common-name genealogy, veteran, obituary, and directory candidates lacked the exact private identifier, a named school tied to the Army entrant, or an explicit OSS connection.
